description: Get the status of a queued request (IN_QUEUE | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED). fal.ai queue: GET {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/status (optional logs=1).

logs.description: Include queue logs in the response (?logs=1).

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

request_id.description: The queue request id returned when the request was submitted.

name: falai_get_request_status
title: Get request status
